Stale Food Seized and Destroyed Across Odisha

Food safety officials in Odisha seized and destroyed a significant quantity of stale sweets and food items. In Bhubaneswar, two quintals of stale sweets were confiscated. Across the state, a total of 3,605 kg of substandard sweets and stale food were destroyed. These actions were carried out by food safety officials.
